newsitem.title: USA: Tenaska, Powerex, SRP form power marketing project.
newsitem.headline: Tenaska, Powerex, SRP form power marketing project.

text.p: Salt River Project (SRP), Tenaska Power Services Co and Canada's Powerex formed a power marketing alliance to provide wholesale electric power throughout western North America, the companies said Thursday.

"This alliance gives us the opportunity to leverage the knowledge we've gained in the gas and independent power industry with the traditional strengths of the electric utility generators to add value in innovative ways," Tenaska's chief executive officer Howard Hawks said in a statement.

As part of the alliance, SRP will make 300 megawatts (MW) of wholesale power available during the winter season, October through May, and Powerex will make 300 MW available for purchase during the spring and summer months, they said.
Tenaska will construct or acquire up to 300 MW for sale year-round as well as provide fuel and other management services, the three companies said.
All parties will market the alliance product throughout the western U.S. and into Mexico and Canada. For energy buyers, the alliance offers year-round flexibility, they said.

SRP is the third-largest public power utility in the U.S., serving much of the Southwest region. Powerex, the electricity marketing subsidiary of British Columbia Hydro and Power Authority. Tenaska is an independent power producer and marketer of natural gas and electricity.
